official_stats.stat: The National Consumer Helpline registered more than 5.1 lakh complaints against e-commerce and quick-commerce platforms in 2025, up about 14% from 4.4 lakh in 2024.
official_stats.source: Consumer Affairs Ministry reply in the Lok Sabha, via Inc42

official_stats.stat: The top complaint types were non-delivery (79,818), wrong product delivered (75,426) and refunds not paid (61,056), the same themes as this report's top pain points. The figures do not break out food delivery or Swiggy.
